name: codex-director
description: Project-scoped director workflow for Codex worker-thread coordination, explicit worker workflow skills, signal-first monitoring, research, oracle, review, goals, and evidence gates.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate project work across Codex worker threads with quiet, signal-first monitoring.
interface.longDescription: A project-scoped director workflow for routing, planning, Codex worker-thread coordination, explicit $director-* worker workflow skills, signal-first worker callbacks with child-thread readback, helper/subagent lanes for non-trivial workers, heartbeat watchdogs, research, oracle checks, adversarial review, goals, git/worktree policy, and concise evidence reporting.
defaultPrompt: Start $codex-director in this current thread for this project. Title it as <Project Display Name> Director using the stable workspace Director/title emoji convention when available, keep that parent title stable across task focus changes, restore it with set_thread_title if the app auto-title layer drifts it, pin it when available, coordinate only, and do not inspect, edit, test, deploy, or query production inline.

Use $codex-director to coordinate this task with Codex worker threads, explicit $director-* workflow skills, dynamic workflow when warranted, helper/subagent lanes for non-trivial workers, and review/oracle gates; always record each worker or packet's selected workflow/playbook and top-level control loop before dispatch and in ledger/status entries. Accept Director-created workers only after child-thread readback and evidence reconciliation. Direct leaf is worker-internal only for tiny/mechanical/low-risk work. A coordinator final checkpoint is not final task completion until the Director dispatches the next worker, records its monitor, or records a dispatch blocker/approval wait. Pending worktree ids count as active handles and must stay monitored.
Use $codex-director to audit active project work from the Director ledger; dispatch workers with explicit $director-* workflow skills for any repo/docs/code/prod-backed status.
